{{Quote|I know we have to change ships here, but I just don't like the look of it.|C-3PO, in Zallakesh|<ref name="Coby" />}}
'''Chuzalla''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]]. It had a significant population of dangerous criminals and was the site of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zallakesh]]. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the [[Tammuz-an (species)/Legends|Tammuz-an]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Coby]], accompanied by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jann Tosh]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], was forced to transfer to a connecting flight in Zallakesh while traveling between the worlds [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] and [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]].

During the quartet's stop there, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Stroon]] and [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] [[Slarm (Human)|Slarm]] of the [[Starhunter menagerie ark|cruiser]] of the traveling sideshow [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]], who at the time were visiting Chuzalla on a supply run, stole Coby's rare and valuable [[Tessellated Arboreal binjinphant|pet]] [[Ingey]]. The cruiser subsequently departed for the planet [[Dandelo]]; however, Coby and his droid companions followed the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in a [[Blackhawk Destroyer|vessel]] of their own.

==Description==
Chuzalla was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="DroidsReAnimated" /> located in the [[Chuzalla system/Legends|Chuzalla system]], a part of the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> From [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Chuzalla's surface appeared [[Color/Legends|blue]] in color and had areas that made for significant deviations from a spherical planetary shape. Another blue-colored celestial body apppeared relatively large when viewed from Chuzalla's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] on Chuzalla featured [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]], and the sky there could exhibit blue and pink tones.<ref name="Coby" />

==History==
{{Quote|Don't worry about it, 3PO. If we're lucky, our connecting flight to the Academy should be waiting.|Jann Tosh, to C-3PO while arriving on Chuzalla|<ref name="Coby" />}}
[[File:Chuzalla_spaceport.png|thumb|right|300px|The starship aboard which Prince Coby, Jann Tosh, C-3PO, and R2-D2 were forced to stop at Zallakesh on Chuzalla.]]
In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} dates the events of [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']], which includes "[[Coby and the Starhunters]], to fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before those of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Tammuz-an (species)/Legends|Tammuz-an]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Coby]], accompanied by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jann Tosh]], the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], traveled aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from<ref name="Coby" /> the planet<ref name="CSWE Tammuz-an">{{CSWECite|III|216|Tammuz-an}}</ref> [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] to<ref name="Coby" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Imperial Army Academy]] on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> world<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], into which the prince had been accepted. However, en route their vessel suffered a malfunction in a vital [[Computer/Legends|computer]] chip, forcing them<ref name="DroidsReAnimated" /> to transfer to a connecting flight from<ref name="Coby" /> the [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="EAOC2009">{{SWArchive|url=atlas/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion}}</ref> [[Zallakesh]].<ref name="Coby" />

At the same time,<ref name="Coby" /> the [[Starhunter menagerie ark|cruiser]] of the traveling sideshow known as the [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]]<ref name="CSWE Starhunter">{{CSWECite|III|187|Starhunter Intergalactic Menagerie}}</ref> was visiting Zallakesh on a supply run. When the Menagerie's<ref name="Coby" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Stroon]] and his [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] and assistant, [[Slarm (Human)|Slarm]],<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> noticed Coby's rare and valuable pet [[Tessellated Arboreal binjinphant]] [[Ingey]], they stole it, and, when Coby demanded that they release the animal, they instead lifted off in their [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], preparing to depart for their hidden base on<ref name="Coby" /> the planet [[Dandelo]].<ref name="FarHorizons">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>

Coby and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companions in turn gave chase in a [[Blackhawk Destroyer]] starship purchased at the local [[Honest Tobar's Used Spacecraft]] shop, although the trio's out-of-control flight over Zallakesh eventually left them nearly out of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] before they had fully caught up with Stroon's cruiser. However, they ultimately used their craft's [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] landing gear to attach it to the cruiser, after which the two connected vessels jumped to the [[Dandelo system]].<ref name="Coby" /> Tosh was thereby left alone and confused on Chuzalla's surface, although he<ref name="DroidsReAnimated" /> eventually also followed R2-D2's [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] to Dandelo.<ref name="Coby" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Everything dangerous and criminal likes to call Zallakesh home.|C-3PO|<ref name="Coby" />}}
Chuzalla had a significant population of dangerous criminals.<ref name="DroidsReAnimated" /> Its city<ref name="EAOC2009" /> Zallakesh was inhabited by Humans and members of other [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Coby" /> Although the settlement was lawless,<ref name="EAOC2009" /> it nevertheless employed [[Zallakesh prison ship|prison ships]].<ref name="Coby" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Zallakesh. Disembark at your own risk.|A Zallakesh spaceport announcement|<ref name="Coby" />}}
Chuzalla was the site of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]<ref name="DroidsReAnimated" /> city<ref name="EAOC2009" /> Zallakesh. It contained the starship store Honest Tobar's Used Spacecraft.<ref name="Coby" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TammuzAnSpaceport-CobyAndTheStarhunters.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO'' episode "Coby and the Starhunters" re-used the animation sequence used to depict a spaceport on Tammuz-an to also depict a scene set on Chuzalla.]]
The celestial body on which the city Zallakesh was located first appeared in "[[Coby and the Starhunters]],"<ref name="Coby" /> the ninth episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'', which aired on [[November 2]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> On [[November 24]], [[2009]], the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[August 18]], 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] introduced the Chuzalla [[Star system/Legends|system]] as the site of Zallakesh,<ref name="EAOC2009" /> placing it, and thereby the corresponding celestial body, in grid square T-14.<ref name="EAOC" /> Finally, the [[July 5]], [[2013]] StarWars.com article "[[The Droids Re-Animated|The Droids Re-Animated, Part 2]]" by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] identified Zallakesh's location as the planet Chuzalla.<ref name="DroidsReAnimated" />

In "Coby and the Starhunters," an animation sequence used to depict a [[Tammuz-an spaceport|spaceport]] on<ref name="Coby" /> Tammuz-an<ref name="DroidsReAnimated" /> is later re-used for depicting a scene on Zallakesh.<ref name="Coby" /> In addition, [[John Bradley Snyder]]'s article "[[A Star Wars CELibration]]," published in<ref name="Insider27" /> the [[October]] [[1995]]<ref name="InsiderDate">[[Star Wars Insider 27|''Star Wars Insider'' 27's]] copyright is dated to [[1995]], while the "[[Star Wars Around the World|''Star Wars'' Around the World]]" department of the magazine issue indicates that it was published both after [[October 21]] and prior to [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'']]{{'s}} release on [[November 3]].</ref> [[Star Wars Insider 27|twenty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine includes a brief summary of the episode's plot which erroneously claims that Coby's pet Ingey is stolen at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|academy]] to which the prince is traveling,<ref name="Insider27" /> as opposed to in Zallakesh.<ref name="Coby" />
